messages:
marta: Heads-up: opened docs PR #8421 to add a 'time-sync & HSM' runbook for Private installs — saw two customer incidents where HSM PKCS11 errors correlated with clock drift after node reprovision. Need quick patch + sample chrony/systemd snippet + egress rule callouts.
devon: link to PR? i'll review. also we should add a k8s initContainer example for airgapped installs.
marta: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/8421 — draft. main additions: chrony conf, systemd-timesyncd fallback, kube init-container that runs `chronyc makestep` at boot, and firewall ports: UDP/123 (NTP); callout to vendor HSM ports in vendor docs. Need verify for YubiHSM vs SoftHSM.
sanjay: nit: don't use `makestep` unguarded, add a conditional check for large leap. sample snippet: ```sh
# init container
if ! chronyc tracking | grep -q 'System time' ; then
  chronyc makestep
fi
```
kevin: :thumbsup: Also add a 'how to validate' section showing openssl engine pkcs11 errors and `journalctl -u redwood-hsm` grep examples. Eg: `journalctl -u redwood-hsm | grep -E 'PKCS11|token'`
docs-bot: Spellcheck: 'chrony' spelled correctly. Link-check pending.
ops-oncall: For private installs behind NAT, remember outbound NTP via egress proxy needs to allow UDP/123. Also add note for hardware HSMs that some vendors optionally use NTP-over-TLS or vendor-managed time sync — link vendor doc: https://vendor.example/hsm-ntp
marta: I'll update the PR with snippets and validation steps. Plan: 1) add chrony conf with fallback to local server; 2) add systemd-timesyncd snippet as alternative; 3) k8s init container examples for airgap (use internal NTP or staged sync); 4) link-check and add reviewer list @kevin @devon @sanjay. Target merge EOD tomorrow.
devon: Quick wording: in airgap note prefer `chrony -q`/`chronyd -q`? Use `chronyc` commands in examples. Also include a tiny flow diagram (internal ntp -> node -> hsm).
marta: Pushed update: added chrony.conf example and `chronyc` commands, added test commands: `timedatectl show --property=NTPSynchronized` and placeholder validation `openssl pkcs11 -T`.
sanjay: LGTM but please use `systemctl restart chronyd` in snippet not `service`.
kevin: Added small firewall snippets for iptables and nftables and lines for Azure NSG/AWS SG: allow UDP/123 outbound and list vendor HSM ports (documented).
marta: docs-bot: run link-checker please — PR ready for review.
docs-bot: Link-check started. 1 broken internal link found: /docs/private/hsm-timeout -> fix to /docs/private/hsm-time-sync. Pushing automated redline.
devon: I can review after link fix. @marta add short migration note for customers who ran into this so we can email when doc lands.
marta: Will add migration note and a quick e2e checklist for support: steps to check time, restart hsm service, re-enroll key.
ops-oncall: Sanity test commands to include: `date -R`, `chronyc tracking`, `openssl s_client -connect hsm:1792 -servername hsm`.
marta: :smile: thanks all. merging after approvals. PR number stays #8421. I'll backport to 1.12 branch.
